comment: Template for tools/vault-abgleich.mjs. Copy to comfy/reference-config.local.json (ignored by git) and replace every <...> with your own value; see comfy/README.md. The tool sets exactly the keys under settings in each vault's data.json and leaves all others (history, presets, ...) alone.

comfyEndpointChoice.endpointId: <endpoint id in the LLM Endpoint Manager>

endpointManager.endpointId: <endpoint id in the LLM Endpoint Manager>
endpointManager.sourceVault: <vault whose LLM Endpoint Manager holds that endpoint>
